batting.name: NV Ojha
batting.dismissal: c RV Uthappa b JH Kallis

batting.name: MJ Lumb
batting.dismissal: st MV Boucher b A Kumble

batting.name: S Narwal
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b P Kumar

batting.name: M Morkel
batting.dismissal: st MV Boucher b A Kumble

balls.text: and another run-out puts Rajasthan out of their misery. Full looping ball on legstump, played away by Munaf straight to short fine, where Dravid picks and fires in a good throw. Enough time for Boucher to collect and whip the bails. Enough certainty for umpire Harper to give it out without asking for camera assistance.
gotcha! Kumble deceives Morne all ends up, the spin eludes the outside edge and Morne's backfoot goes very slightly outside his crease. Boucher is waiting behind and whips off the bails.
hoick and a miss, the ball thuds into the batsman's thigh and runs away for a leg-bye
outside off and turn away from the right hander. He can't connect.
Hohoho, Jumbo wins the battle of the great leggies! Defeats Warne's attempted pull with a straight fast ball and disturbs timber.
and again, swing and a miss. Great spell from Praveen. He's gone for a few in the past, but kept it really tight today. And the hat-trick does his cause no harm.
guided away towards cover for a couple. For a man who aims to emulate Mathew hayden's batting, Morne is struggling a bit for timing.
thin air yet again for Morne. Nice changes in pace from Praveen.
over the wicket, and really slow short ball, Morne can't connect.
short again and angling into Morne, he tries to pull but can't get any timing.
short outside off, and lacking in pace. Warne works it away towards midwicket for one.
slow again, outside the left-hander's offstump. Play and miss.
even slower - 97 kph. Warne waits and waits and inside edges it onto his boot for a single to cover.
nice slower ball, full on leg, Warne can't get it away
down the track, and hits the length ball straight down, the fumble by long off lets him take two
short again, looks to upper-cut and times thin air to perfection, but the ball is through to Boucher.
short again, airy pull from Warne and makes no contact.
short one yet again, and the batsman cannot connect.
play and a miss outside off by Morne Morkel

three in three for Praveen!!! First hat-trick of IPL 2010! Straight and as fast as Praveen can be, and it is good enough for Dogra. Middle stump is out of the ground and Praveen roars! Rajasthan going down in a hurry here.

another bouncer, another wicket! Dug in by Praveen, Narwal was in no position, but went through with the pull. Manish pandey ran in a long way from fine leg, and juggled a couple of times before holding on.
and that's the end of that. Praveen comes back with an inch-perfect yorker that made up for lack of pace, with accuracy. Marto misses, Praveen hits, see you later.
finally a four for Martyn, but only since mid on was inside the circle. Swings the full ball over the infield.
starts off with a wayward ball, outside off. Swings away for good measure, easy call of wide
distinct change of pace, down to 105 kph. Martyn completes his backlift, waits and waits and finally hits it towards short cover. Don't even ask about the timing.
gets it away this time towards third man for a run.
and again! Hits him on the helmet this time. Rajasthan need to find a way to counter this - the other teams will be watching keenly.
I swear I thought that was a replay. Same ball, same result. Dogra being dogged by the short ones.
another good short one, another swish and a miss. That's the 50th dot ball of the innings.
slow, but accurate bouncer and Rajasthan are not able to get them away or shake the bowlers off their lengths today.
draws him forward, Dogra drives it down to long on for a run
short of a length and played away towards short third man, Kumble appeals for something.
down the track and looks to drive, but can't get any kind of timing going. Martyn's having a nightmare so far.
shorter, faster googly and Kumble rents out a big appeal as it hits the pads.
full on leg stump, played away towards midwicket.

he's a goner! Bangalore can't catch Yusuf, but can run him out! Tip and run towards cover by Martyn, Virat Kohli swoops in and throws down the stumps in one silken smooth action. Third umpire called into action, but Yusuf knew he was caught short. Well done Kohli!

another drop! Again short, again pulled unconvincingly. It goes real high, and Vinay Kumar covers a lot of ground from long on to cow-corner, but cannot keep the ball in as he tumbles. Would have been a very good catch if he'd pulled it off.
this time Yusuf calls him. Full and fast this time, but he was waiting for it and spanked it through the covers for four.
much shorter, Yusuf swings and misses. Something's gotta give here.
and again, he's caught in no-man's land and can't get bat on the short of a length ball outside off
on a length, and Yusuf can't work it away. He's staying back, expecting short balls. Great work from Bangalore
full and fast from Steyn, and Martyn's not got any of that silken timing going today. Stutters to deep cover for one
square drives the fullish ball on offstump for a single. Martyn needs to step up a gear somehow.

Dravid's put down the big one! Another short one, Yusuf again got it high on the bat, Dravid ran all across Bangalore, from square leg to mid wicket and did everything except hold on to it. Maybe, Uthappa from long on had a better chance of taking the catch.
and he bounces him yet again. This was really dug in, and was on the verge of being called a wide.
Martyn just can't break free. Again tries to make room, but Kallis keeps it tight and he can only work it away feebly for a quick single towards midwicket
loses the line on this occasion, the attempted slower ball slips well down the legside for a wide.
around the stumps again to Yusuf, and he drives off the backfoot towards long off for one
follows Martyn's movements towards the legside well, keeps it full on legstump. He digs it out towards the offside, but can't get it away for more than one.
holds his guns and bowls another slower ball, fuller this time. Yusuf tries to work it away, but misses.
and again! Slower ball, and very short this time. Sits up and asks to be hit, Yusuf obliges. That was really big over long on.
length ball and Yusuf smacks his lips before smacking the ball high over long on for the first six of the day! Vinay pays the price for wavering from the script.
and again. He's not very comfortable against the short ball, even at a pace of 126 kph, hit flush on the helmet.
done in by the lack of pace. Yusuf is through with the pull shot before Vinay reaches him at 124 kph.
Drifts onto the pads, Martyn plays it nicely towards square leg for a run.
short of a length, and going from middle to off stump. Yusuf plays it off the backfoot but can't pass midwicket.
another very good bouncer, another attempted pull, and another miss. Very well directed once again.
Fulltoss, probably the first of the day, outside off and Martyn can't take advantage.
safely tucked away towards square leg for a single.
slower ball, and again the batsman somehow survives! Mis-hits towards mid-on, and runs a single.
hurries him with a bouncer! Top edges the pull, and it somehow lands safe after staying up for an eternity over midwicket
again, short and fast, Yusuf plays it away to the left of point, where Kohli tumbles and saves, but can't stop the scampered single
this time he does, but makes no connection. Recorded at 149.9, really short again. Through to Boucher.
Speed is in for Yusuf! Fast and short outside off, and Yusuf does not flirt with it.
short and drifting into Yusuf's ribcage, plays it down safely.
makes room (or was he running away from the pace?), but Steyn follows him towards legstump. Played away towards deep point for a run.
146 kph. Steyn fires that in short of a length, and Martyn misses the cut
and again, similar ball but played away for a single off the backfoot
shortens the length and fires it in on the offstump line. Kumble is mixing it up really well here.
has Martyn in trouble, with a looping legspinner on leg stump. Rapped on the front pads but not enough turn
worked away from legstump towards fine leg for a single
on the same length, Martyn quietly plays off the backfoot towards cover.
short of a length, drifting towards middle and leg, played away quietly for a single
chops away the short ball, behind square for a run

he has his man this time! Kallis has his karma! Cuts in from a length outside off, creeps in off the inside edge, through the gap between bat and pad, and disturbs the stumps. Kallis is pleased, Kumble is pumped, Rajasthan are in trouble!
he makes room and carves it over point this time. Rubbing salt into Kallis' wounds with a four!
Jhunjhunwala escapes! Definite edge on that one, the fielding team was sure they had him but umpire Hariharan is unmoved.
same length, different reaction. Big swing and a miss from Jhunjhunwala.
length ball again, Bangalore has done really well on that front. Martyn guides it away off the backfoot for a run towards cover
slightly shorter, guided away towards point but can't get it past
flighted googly again, slower as well and beats the batsman's prod
flicked away from outside off towards short midwicket for a run
on a length, gets on the front foot and drives for a single.

he's a goner! Kumble does Lumb in with a beauty. Slow looped googly, around 86 kph, Lumb is drawn out and left stranded by the flight and turn away from him. Boucher does the rest. The openers are gone.
quick and angled across, pushed to mid off
and he ramps it up this time! Another good bouncer, this time tops 141 kph and Martyn takes evasive action.
nice bouncer there. Well-directed and Martyn has to duck to avoid being hit. 135 plus kph.
again short of a length and Lumb pushes it towards long on off the backfoot for one.
Martyn's off the mark. On a length, he stays back and calmly guides it to third man.
very good slower ball, Lumb plays a couple of pulls, and does not time it at all. Free-hit wasted.
free hit coming up. Kallis oversteps and Lumb will look to break free

and he strikes immediately! Tight and short of a length on offstump and Ojha is desperate to break free. Goes for that carve over covers again, hits high on the bat, and loops to Robin Uthappa at cover for a simple catch
nice finish to the over after that four, keeps it outside off on a length, Lumb swings and misses
short of a length outside off and Ojha looks to play a Sehwagesque carve over point, very nearly carries to third man.
good short ball, directed at Ojha's head and he's cramped for room, can't make contact on the attempted pull.
Lumb walks down a pace and looks to carve it over cover, but it goes fine for a run
clipped towards square leg for a single. Over to Lumb
righto! Bowling change works.. for the batsman! Ojha swings the full ball on legstump over square leg for four.
back to full pace, runs it off the backfoot down to third man for a single. Rajasthan off to a sedate start here.
slower ball this time on off stump, short of a length and defended towards cover
this time he slips down the leg side for a wide. 149 kph. Steyn needs to tweak the radar a bit, now that he's hit top gear.
similar ball, gets bat on it this time, but straight to square leg
151 kph this time! A little off the mark, it's on legstump, short of a length but Ojha can't capitalise
pacy again - 148 kph, and Ojha gets behind it nicely and defends
thuds into the batsman's pads and runs away towards the offisde for a run.
slower ball and Lumb goes through with the shot over midwicket after coming down the track. It falls safe between two fielders
on a length, on off and Lumb can't pierce the gap through the offside
Lumb jumps down the track, but the length is not there for the big hit. It's short of a length and Lumb fails to make good contact and his biff dribbles to mid on
again on a length outside off, no movement and steered off the backfoot for a single behind square.
commentator's curse! Praveen drifts well down legside this time.
and again, good lines from Praveen. Ojha defends the length ball, off the backfoot towards the offside.
on a length, and safely blocked towards the offside by Ojha for no run
drifts on to Ojha's pads and he clips it square, nicely off the back foot. It's cut off close to the ropes, but the batsmen run three.
gets inside the line and works away another well-directed ball towards fine leg for a run
he's through him! Pacy delivery and Lumb ic caught deep in the crease and plays all over it.
swing and a miss outside off
looks to flick it towards leg and misses, but he moved outside off, and hence though it hits his pads, Lumb is not plumb.
flicked and mis-fielded by Manish Pandey at square leg and the batsmen run through for three. Steyn topped 143 kph there.
short of a length again, worked away off the backfoot in the direction of third man to round off the over.
driven square to Steyn sweeping, and Boucher tumbles as he takes the return
and he's off the mark in streaky fashion! Short of a length, angling away again and Lumb pokes at it tentatively through the vacant second slip for four.
swings with the angle, away from the left-handed Lumb who shoulders arms
shortens the length slightly, tapped away towards point and they are off for a tight single
on a length, swinging in slightly, batsman gets forward and defends.
well, that's that then. Pandey will go home unsated, as Kallis works it down to fine leg for the match-winning single.
Pandey will be going mad at the non-striker's end, as Narwal seems intent on denying him a chance to finish it off with a boundary. Another wide down leg.
on offstump this time and Kallis looks to work it away to the legside, but does not succeed.
slow, short and wide down the legside. Kallis looks to swat it, as he would deal with one of those moths in Ahmedabad, but can't connect.
strange stuff. Kallis walks down again, and then looks to pull the short ball, does not connect and ends up on his knees.
moves towards the offside and looks to whip it towards midwicket but can't make connection.
Kallis is in no hurry, plays it away quietly towards square for another run.
looks to deposit it over deep midwicket, and just about gets it to mid on for a run. Four to win.
there, again. Pandey decided this one had to go, but it was short, a mile away from him and swung away a bit as well. Just about pulled out of the shot in the end.
pushes the length ball off the backfoot behind square for another single
picks the length early, rocks back and makes room to carve it over cover and hits it well, but the sweeper suts it off.
guides the short ball easily off the backfoot, behind square on the offside
and again! Whaddashot! Picks the short ball and pulls it fiercely over midwicket for six!

whacko jacko! Every now and then, Pandey decides to unleash mayhem and more often than not, makes good contact. Again, nowhere near the length, but he'd decided this was going to long off come what may. It did.
check drive from Pandey, to a length ball, towards point for no run
short and gets big on Kallis who again walks down, the edge goes in the air for a while, but lands safely before reaching third man.
wide down the legside. Fifth wide of the innings.
Kallis jumps out of the crease and looks to counter the swing, it is shorter, and he works it away for a quick couple. Good aggressive intent, but only from one team today.
edged, and four! Drew Kallis forward with a hint of away movement, but there was no slip, and it may not have carried anyway. All the way for four.
and a super ball to finish off. Sharp spin, beats Pandey's outside edge by inches. Warney's got the leggie going well, but no variations in spin.
no respect this time! Picks the length, chooses to sweep and mows it over midwicket for four.
shortens the length and Pandey treats it with respect. Taps it away.
hits him flush on the toe, but outside leg. Warne lets out a big appeal nevertheless.
full on legstump, and Kallis sweeps it well along the ground for a run to deep square.
short of a length outside off, and played away towards the offside for a run.
short ball on middle and the batsman pulls out the pull, but can't get it past mid on.
good ball, darts back into Pandey and hits the pads, big appeal, but its turned down. There was probably some bat involved.
fuller, and hits Kallis' pads but outside offstump.
blocks away the length ball for no run.
his first bad ball, and Manish Pandey leaps on it like a tiger that's not eaten in days! Rocks back and cuts away the long hop through the covers for four.
good length again, Pandey safely plays it away as it turns from leg to off.
worked away towards mid on off the backfoot for a tight run
bowling! The classical legspinner, from outside leg, turning and taking the right-hander's outside edge
fuller and elicits the drive to long off
turns in from outside leg, Kallis can't connect the sweep.
super shot! What hands from Manish Pandey! Again picks the length early and drives on the up, but safely down the ground through mid off. That was four from the moment he hit it.
and again, can't get it through square.
similar ball, similar shot, though he opened the face slightly lesser this time according to Venkat Raghav, our numerically oriented scorer.
opens the face of the bat and forces off the backfoot
and the anti-thesis to orthodox batting! Pandey picks the length early, and though it is short of a length, goes through with a forehand cross court, straight down the ground for four.
whaddashot! That could have easily been Kallis batting in a Test match. High elbow, beautiful timing, all along the ground, through long off for four.
offstump line, and Kallis stays on the backfoot. Defends it to the leg side. Bangalore don't need to rush here, and Kallis certainly isn't.
tight call from umpire Hariharan. Slightly wider than the previous ball, but it was still a smidgeon inside the tramlines.
and again, he's finally got some kind of rhythm going hopefully. Kallis lets it go outside off.
moves outside off this time, finally. Kallis hops back and defends it towards cover.
better line this time, angles in on off and middle short of a length, Kallis can't get it away on the legside.
well, he's really struggling with his line here, another shocker down the legside, meat and drink for the in-form Kallis who sends it off to fine leg for four.

super catch or is it? Pandey slices the short of a length ball in ungainly fashion. It loops up to mid off where the lanky Morne Morkel swoops down and takes it, millimeters off the ground, but did it bounce before he came up with it? Replays are inconclusive and the third umpire decides not out. Pandey stays.
kicks up off a length and catches Kallis by surprise, but he manages to safely play it down to third man for a single
similar ball, looks to work it towards the leg side, but can't get it away.
good line, just outside off and pushing Kallis onto the backfoot. He taps it away towards the offside.
outside off, just short of a length, Manish Pandey stays back and nicely guides it away square on the offside for a run
its on legstump again, Kallis turns it away easily behind square for another single.
short of a length, angling into leg, clipped away off the backfoot for a single through square leg.
back to the old line, well down the leg for a wide.
good bouncer! Good length and great direction, and has Kallis in a mess. Somehow gets it away for four, just over the slips.
finally gets it outside off, defended off the backfoot towards point.
well, no signs of a change of plans. Morne pitches on leg again, and Kallis once again clips it sweetly for four through mid on.
and again! This could end in double quick time unless Rajasthan recalibrates its radar.
the horror, the horror! Drifts way down the leg for a wide.
and again! Slightly shorter, but Kallis is in superb form, times it really nice for four more in the same direction. Bad bowling this, with two slips and a gully.
Morne is replacing Tait in the side, but starts in similar style. Drifts onto the pads and Kallis tucks in easily, all along the carpet for four to midwicket.
better line and great lift from a length, cuts Pandey into two as it jags back ever so slightly, through to the keeper.
and again, this time worked away in more conventional fashion for two.
clears the front foot and swings the straight ball toward midwicket. Poor bowling since the field is set for the offstump line.
on a length, at Munaf-pace - 131 kph, nudged away towards mid on for one.
taps away the length ball towards the legside for a cheeky run
and already, a marked difference in approach and intent! Full and drifting onto the pads and lofted confidently over midwicket for a four.
